data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'sybille', meaning 'prophetes' or 'seeress'. In Greek mythology, Sybil was a priestess who possessed the power to foretell the future. Her name became synonymous with those who possessed spiritual gifts and the ability to see beyond the present. The name Sybyl carries the meaning “Prophetes, seeress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sybyl usually hope their child will grow to embody prophetes, seeress and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name carries a sense of mystery and the uncanny ability to see into the future, often associated with prophets, seers, and those who possess psychic abilities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Sybil represents the gift of prophecy and the ability to see beyond the present.
